newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA'S SUNDS WINS CHILEAN ORDER.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA'S SUNDS WINS CHILEAN ORDER.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma's Sunds Defibrator unit said in a statement on Friday it had won a "sizeable" order for panel handling systems from Chilean Fibramold S.A.
"Fibramold S.A. has ordered from Sunds Defibrator equipment for its new fiber-based door panel factory in Chile," it said.
Kimmo Kiviniemi, managing director of the Nestola-based subsidiary Sunds Defibrator Panelhandling Oy said the parties had agreed not to publish the value of the deal.
"It is not hundreds of millions of markka ... but here in Nastola, it gives a good basic load for next year," he said.
The subsidiary's net sales this year were some 130 million markka, he added.
"The order includes equipment from chip handling up to the packaging line for the ready-made doorskin products, with the exception of humidification and paint-line equipment," it said.
The system would be delivered from Sunds Defibrator units in New Zealand, Sweden, Finland and Chile in September 1997, and the start-up would be in mid 1998.
Fibramold S.A. is a joint venture associated with Chilean Fibranova S.A., it said.
The plant, located in Cabrero, will produce some 5.5 million doorskins a year to be sold in Chile and exported.
